summary: Frontend-only E2E test for Felipillon premium website. Verified all 14 routes load (status 200), Navbar primary nav (6 links), theme toggle + persistence via localStorage 'felipillon-theme', mobile menu (all 12 NAV_LINKS), Home hero CTAs navigation to /staffing /services /open-roles, all home sections (trusted-by, divisions, industries-preview, why, metrics, footprint, home-testimonials), Open Roles search/dept/location filters and pagination (9 roles -> 3 pages of 4), Apply button toast, Contact form validation (error toast when empty, success toast when filled), book-consultation toast, Testimonials carousel prev/next changes content, Blog featured article and category filters (reduces 5 -> 1). No console errors / page errors observed on any tested route.

issues: NAV_LINKS in src/data/content.js contains only 12 entries; routes '/testimonials' and '/contact' are not in the mobile menu list. Contact has a dedicated CTA button, but Testimonials page is not directly reachable from the nav (only accessible via direct URL or other in-page links). Consider adding it to NAV_LINKS or footer for discoverability.

action_items: Optional: Add 'Testimonials' (and possibly 'Contact') to NAV_LINKS so they appear in the mobile menu / footer for completeness.
critical_code_review_comments: OpenRoles.jsx pagination buttons (page numbers) lack individual data-testid (e.g. data-testid='page-1'); querying via parent [data-testid='pagination'] works but per-page testid would be more robust.
ThemeContext sets dark theme via documentElement.classList toggling; light mode results in className '' (empty). Persistence verified via localStorage key 'felipillon-theme'. Works as expected.
All key interactive elements have data-testid attributes - good testability.
seed_data_creation: None - all content static from src/data/content.js.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 14 routes return 200 and render without console errors. Theme toggle persists to localStorage key 'felipillon-theme' (values: 'dark' | 'light'). OpenRoles: ROLES has 9 entries, PER_PAGE=4 -> 3 pagination pages; DEPARTMENTS=['All','Healthcare','Renewable Energy','Construction','Technology']; LOCATIONS_FILTER=['All','Berlin, DE','Pune, IN','Makati City, PH','Remote'] - location testids encode both space and comma to '-' so 'Berlin, DE' -> 'loc-filter-berlin--de'. Sonner toasts can be detected via document.querySelectorAll('[data-sonner-toast]'). Mobile menu opens via [data-testid='mobile-menu-toggle'] and reveals [data-testid='mobile-menu'].
